key_insight: Enhanced state features and reward shaping improve deep reinforcement learning flow control across synthetic jet positions, achieving 8%–34% drag reduction at Reynolds numbers of 100–400.
engineering_relevance: More adaptable synthetic jet control could jointly reduce drag, suppress lift and vortex shedding, and lower actuation energy consumption.
method: Control flow using deep reinforcement learning and synthetic jets.
Enhance dynamic state features and reshape the reward function.
Evaluate control across Reynolds numbers and jet positions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 8%–34% drag reduction over Reynolds numbers of 100–400, with baseline control increasingly sensitive to jet position as Reynolds number rises.
watch_item: Performance beyond Reynolds numbers of 100–400 and transfer to physical hardware are not established in the abstract.
paper_title: Toward fully stabilized flow control using deep reinforcement learning
